title: Here we are yet again.
text: HERE WE ARE YET AGAIN. It is March 24, 2026. Hours ago, I stepped off a very long flight from Edinburgh where Jeff Hays, Maude Garrett, and I just wrapped our very first UK book tour. Every single stop was sold out. It was amazing, exhilarating, and overwhelming. I have less than 24 hours before I have to get on another flight to New Zealand for my event there. Then I’m off to NYC again. Then Denver. Then another full-blown tour. Everything is different now. Writing something that you know will be read by literally thousands of people is goddamned terrifying. Without naming names, I understand now how some people can get…clogged. Luckily for me, I still love this so very much. My mind is always in the dungeon. I’m already hard at work for Dungeon Crawler Carl’s penultimate book, and I don’t want it to end. As they say, once you enter the dungeon… Thank you, everyone, for changing my life. And as always, please leave a review. Boop.
